features: Exact parent D1 DELTA14, without PR or with original per-patient full-channel population Z, still14D; no Raw encoder, added features, patient/center inputs or new extraction
linear_svm: sklearn SVC(kernel='linear', probability=False), same parent RBF selected C in each fold; no gamma or new C search. FIT imputer/StandardScaler, patient-equal then FIT inverse class-frequency initial weights, original cache512/no max_iter limit.
svm_calibration: Exact parent3-fold GroupKFold shuffled by42+1009*fold inside FIT. Each subfold fits its own imputer/scaler/SVC; patient-held-out OOF margins train LogisticRegression Platt C1e6, patient-only weights. Final SVC fits legalFIT only. Validation/Outer never calibrate.
adaboost: sklearn1.7.2 discrete SAMME, DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=1), native predict_proba, FIT-only mean imputer/no global scaling; same initial patient-equal then inverse FIT-class weights. Algorithm subsequently reweights misclassified examples; do not claim equal patient total at every boosting round.
selection: AdaBoost shared config per fold selected by arithmetic mean across both PR arms of validation patient Macro-F1, AP, AUROC, earlier grid index, matching parent paired selection. Each arm keeps own validation threshold. SVM C fixed from previous paired validation-selected RBF, shared across arms; only own threshold selected. No FIT+validation refit.
threshold: Parent validation-only EZ probability grid0:0.005:1, patient Macro-F1 then EZ-F1 then nearest0.5 then lower threshold; predEZ=(pEZ>=threshold)
split: Exact original five outer FIT/validation/test patient-disjoint partitions. Both PR arms explicitly requested before any current run; no new seeds.
outer: Freeze all20 new model/preprocessor/calibrator/threshold bundles before one sealed Outer pass. Reuse exact frozen old RBF-SVM scores in both PR arms only as reference; no old-model retraining or test tuning.
privacy: Publish only code/hashes/anonymous aggregates. Individual features/predictions/labels/IDs, fitted models, scalers and logs stay on trusted server. Do not touch unrelated GPU/CPU jobs.
